exposure: Nb2-N6 aggregate results and Zhou2025 narrative already inspected. No new A20 marker/gene estimates inspected. Exploratory source eligibility and context analysis, not confirmation.
unit: source sample_id x author_celltype; source preparations not individual cells
selection: Author AF1/AF2; independent markers are crosswalk checks, never relabel/reselect by receptor or outcome. All source days retained for coverage only; fixed day42 primary comparison.
normalization: Sum integer counts within source sample/subtype; denominator is sum of all genes in counts layer. log2(CPM+1), gene and mean-panel differences AF1 minus AF2; detection proportions secondary.
summary: Paired source sample differences, n, median, full observed range and signs. No cell-level P values, population CI, fitted causal model, stage-effect or intervention-effect estimate. Display individual paired values and sample round.
sensitivity: Fixed floor20/100 and keep-doublets; individual genes and full predefined collagen panel; compare overlap to earlier Nb2 extraction. No outcome-based exclusions or favorable panel selection.
eligibility: Direct H1/H2 require comparable Fzd1/Fzd2 compartment-specific perturbation and independently measured mature epithelial output. RNA is not substituted for secreted support, collagen deposition, subtype conversion, or epithelial maturation.
